notes: EDGE CASE: could be misread as BUYER_ISO - uses buy-adjacent language ('purchase-level finishes', 'condo-quality', client 'may buy later') and a large-sounding number, but the operative budget is a MONTHLY rent ($8,500/mo) for a lease. Monthly budget => RENTER_INQUIRY, not BUYER_ISO. shouldExtractParty=true; address null. Search area LIC.

input.subject: ISO condo-quality 2BR LIC - long lease, $8,500/mo
input.bodyText:
Hi network,

My client is thinking they may buy in a year or two, but for now they want to lease and get to know the neighborhood. Please don't send me sales listings - this is a RENTAL search.

- 2BR / 2BA, condo-quality / new construction finishes
- Long-term lease, 18-24 months, renewal option ideal
- Long Island City, waterfront buildings preferred
- Budget up to $8,500/mo
- Full amenities: doorman, gym, roof deck, parking a plus
- Move-in Oct 1, immaculate credit, will prepay if needed

Even though the number is high, this is a lease, not a purchase. Send available units. Co-broke.

Vivian Castellano
SERHANT.
